lines.en: label mikufirsthall:
scene mikuhall1
: Sensei?! The heck are you doin' over here? You get a day pass to come hang out with us girls in the dorm or somethin'?
lines.zh: : Sensei？！你跑这儿来干吗？你是弄到了什么通行证，好混进我们女生的宿舍来玩还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Nope. Just abusing my power as the lone male authority figure at school and hanging out in places I probably shouldn't be allowed in.
lines.zh: : 没有。只是滥用我作为全校唯一男性权威人物的权力，在这些大概不该让我进的地方晃悠罢了。

lines.en: : Well, as long as ya don't start sneakin' into the locker room, you're still A-Okay in my book!
lines.zh: : 行吧，只要你别开始偷偷溜进更衣室，在我这儿你就还是完全没问题的！

lines.en: : Not sure what kinda fun you're expectin' to have in a place like this, though. All the {i}real{/i} action is goin' on behind closed doors.
lines.zh: : 不过我不知道你指望在这种地方找到什么乐子。{i}真正的{/i}好戏都发生在关着的门后面。

lines.en: : I kind of need to go through the halls in order to get into any of the rooms, but I'll keep your advice in mind, Miku.
lines.zh: : 我要进任何房间，总得先经过走廊吧，不过你的建议我会记在心里的，Miku。

lines.en: scene mikuhall2
: Wait, how come you're talkin' to me, though? The girl with the biggest knockers in school is right behind ya. Probably knows more about {i}action{/i} than me, too.
lines.zh: : 等等，那你干吗要跟我说话啊？全校胸部最大的那个女生就在你后头呢。她对“{i}好戏{/i}”懂得大概也比我多。

lines.en: : Who knows? Maybe I just have a thing for tomboys.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢？也许我就是喜欢假小子。

lines.en: scene mikuhall3
: It ain't nice playin' with a girl's heart like that, Sensei. Don't gotta pity me just cause I can't compete with the rest of the girls in looks.
lines.zh: : 这样玩弄一个女孩子的心可不好，Sensei。你不用因为我在长相上比不过别的女生就可怜我。

lines.en: : Likin' tomboys is one thing, but I ain't really got any other good qualities at all when ya start gettin' down to it. Just soccer and...
lines.zh: : 喜欢假小子是一回事，可真要说起来，我压根就没有别的什么优点了。只有足球，还有……

lines.en: : See, I got nothin'. It's literally just soccer.
lines.zh: : 你看吧，我什么都没有。真的就只有足球。

lines.en: : I'm sure you have tons of other good qualities. I just can't imagine I'll be learning about them in the hallway when, as you said, all the real action is behind closed doors.
lines.zh: : 我相信你还有很多别的优点。只是我没法想象自己能在走廊里了解到它们——毕竟就像你说的，真正的好戏都在关着的门后面。

lines.en: scene mikuhall1
: Hey, that woulda made a great segue thingy if you were tryin' to get into my room right now!
lines.zh: : 嘿，要是你现在正想方设法要进我房间的话，那句话可是个完美的铺垫啊！

lines.en: : That...is exactly what I was doing, Miku.
lines.zh: : 那……正是我在做的事，Miku。

lines.en: scene mikuhall4
: Wait, for real?! Why?!
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？！为什么？！

lines.en: : Maybe I just {i}really{/i} have a thing for tomboys?
lines.zh: : 也许我是{i}真的{/i}特别喜欢假小子？

lines.en: : Must be a pretty huge thing if you're gonna start tryin' to pick me up in the hallway!
lines.zh: : 那得是特别特别喜欢吧，你居然打算在走廊里就开始搭讪我了！

lines.en: : It's pretty big, yeah.
lines.zh: : 是挺大的，没错。

lines.en: scene mikuhall3
: Umm....well I don't really know what to say, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我不知道该说什么好，Sensei。

lines.en: : I like ya and all, but...I don't know if I'm really ready to take whatever steps you're tryin' to make here.
lines.zh: : 我是挺喜欢你的，不过……我不知道自己是不是真的准备好迈出你想让我迈出的那一步了。

lines.en: : B-Besides! I'm already way behind schedule for my nightly run and...I've gotta get started on that as soon as we're done talkin'.
lines.zh: : 再……再说！我每晚的跑步已经比预定时间晚了很多，而且……我们一说完话我就得赶紧出发了。

lines.en: : You're planning on going out this late at night? Isn't that dangerous?
lines.zh: : 你打算这么晚了还出去？不危险吗？

lines.en: scene mikuhall1
: Dangerous? Nah. I can outrun any criminal who tries to start somethin' with me.
lines.zh: : 危险？才不会。任何想找茬的罪犯，我都跑得比他快。

lines.en: : Chances are nobody will do that, though, since most people just confuse me for a boy on account of my...uhh...everything.
lines.zh: : 不过大概也不会有人来找我麻烦，因为大多数人都会把我认成男孩子，就凭我的……呃……一切。

lines.en: : I am both glad to hear that you'll be safe and saddened to hear about the whole {i}mistaken for a boy{/i} thing.
lines.zh: : 听到你会安全我很高兴，听到{i}被认成男孩子{/i}这件事我又很难过。

lines.en: : I ain't too beat up about it. Been dealin' with it forever, pretty much.
lines.zh: : 我倒没太往心里去。基本上从很久以前就一直这样了。

lines.en: : If it's any consolation, you'll always be a girl to me.
lines.zh: : 如果能让你好受一点的话——在我眼里，你永远是个女孩子。

lines.en: scene mikuhall3
: Man, where's all this comin' from, Sensei?! You been readin' one of those books about flirtin' or something lately?
lines.zh: : 天哪，你这些话都是从哪儿冒出来的，Sensei？！你最近是不是看了什么讲搭讪的书之类的？

lines.en: : I don't know if I'd consider calling you a girl {i}flirting...{/i}
lines.zh: : 我不知道把你说成女孩子{i}算不算搭讪……{/i}

lines.en: : You would if you were me! I never hear that kinda stuff from anybody other than Makoto and-
lines.zh: : 你要是我你就会这么觉得！这种话除了 Makoto 之外我从没听别人说过，而且——

lines.en: scene mikuhall4
: Wait a sec! Makoto didn't put ya up to this, did she?!
lines.zh: : 等等！Makoto 不会是派你来的吧？！

lines.en: : She's yelled at me three times this month for leavin' on my runs without pepper spray and she hired {i}you{/i} as an agent to come stop me with your sudden tomboy fetish!
lines.zh: : 这个月她已经因为我不带防狼喷雾就出去跑步骂了我三次了，所以她雇{i}你{/i}当特工，让你用你那突然冒出来的假小子癖来拦住我！

lines.en: : That's-
lines.zh: : 那个——

lines.en: scene mikuhall5
: Darn it, Makoto! I already told ya that the pepper spray doesn't fit into my stupid, undersized pockets!
lines.zh: : 可恶，Makoto！我都说过了，防狼喷雾塞不进我这该死的、小得不正常的口袋里！

lines.en: : Why even put pockets on girl pants in the first place if ya can't friggin' fit anything in 'em?!
lines.zh: : 既然什么都该死地塞不进去，那女裤上到底为什么还要缝口袋啊？！

lines.en: scene mikuhall6
: You got a problem, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你有什么意见吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Nope. Just admiring your abundance of energy even as the day comes to an end.
lines.zh: : 没有。只是佩服你这一天都快过完了，精力还这么旺盛。

lines.en: scene mikuhall1
: Why just admire when you can see it first hand? Come runnin' with me!
lines.zh: : 光是佩服有什么意思，你亲眼看看不就知道了？来跟我一起跑！

lines.en: : I'll show ya my route and we can even stop by Makoto's place so I can yell at her for hirin' an assassin.
lines.zh: : 我带你走我的路线，我们还可以顺路去 Makoto 那儿，好让我冲她吼一顿，骂她雇了个刺客。

lines.en: : As fun as it sounds to watch you yell at Makoto, I think I'm going to pass.
lines.zh: : 看你冲 Makoto 吼听起来是挺有意思，不过我还是算了。

lines.en: : Running's not really my thing.
lines.zh: : 跑步真的不是我的菜。

lines.en: : Nor is...any athletic activity, now that I think about it.
lines.zh: : 而且现在想想，任何体育活动都不是我的菜。

lines.en: : Well, suit yourself! But I can't really hang around here much longer.
lines.zh: : 行吧，随你！不过我也不能在这儿待太久了。

lines.en: : Feel free to drop by again, though! Some of the other girls might be opposed to you hangin' out around here, but I think it's pretty great!
lines.zh: : 不过你随时都可以再来！有些女生可能会反对你在这儿晃悠，但我觉得这样挺好的！

lines.en: scene mikuhall7
: Just make sure ya barricade whatever doors ya wind up behind if you're lookin' for privacy since Makoto's got a key to all of 'em.
lines.zh: : 只是你要是想找个私密的地方，记得把身后的门堵上，因为 Makoto 有所有门的钥匙。

lines.en: scene mikuhall0
: Later, Sensei! Nice talkin' to you!
lines.zh: : 回头见，Sensei！和你聊天很开心！

lines.en: scene black
Miku gets off the ground and sprints down the hall, jumping down a flight of stairs and landing on a small platform before the next.
lines.zh: Miku 从地上站起来，沿着走廊飞奔而去，一跃跳过一段楼梯，落在下一段楼梯前的小平台上。

lines.en: The sound echoes throughout the dorm and seems to startle even her as she needs to take a moment to collect herself after landing.
lines.zh: 那声响在整栋宿舍里回荡，似乎连她自己都吓了一跳，落地后还得缓一缓才能稳住。

lines.en: I turn around to see if Futaba is still here as well but, after realizing she must have gone back into her room, I decide it's probably best to just head home for the night.
lines.zh: 我转过身想看看 Futaba 是不是还在，不过意识到她大概是回自己房间了，我就决定今晚还是直接回家比较好。

lines.en: At least I got to talk to Miku for a bit, though...
lines.zh: 不过至少我还跟 Miku 聊了一会儿……
